[!symlink] skip 'fake GOROOT needs symlinks'
[!cgo] skip 'cgo is not available'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOWORK=off
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=

# With cgo enabled, an inactive cgo-tagged Go file in an owned module
# that imports a LoGOs package no host-active file reaches must still
# have that dependency staged: the eject succeeds and the export builds
# with the selecting tag. Without the discovery the eject succeeds but
# the tagged build fails on the missing support package. The test
# installs fixture packages in a private toolchain root inside $WORK
# and selects it with GOROOT. Nothing is written into the real GOROOT.
go run mkgoroot.go $TESTGO_GOROOT $WORK/fakegoroot dep
env GOROOT=$WORK/fakegoroot

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^feat$'

logos eject -o out
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/logos/ejecttestcgoleaf/leaf.go

cd out
go build ./...
go build -tags native ./...
go vet -tags native ./...

-- mkgoroot.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"
)

func must(err error, what string) {
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "mkgoroot: %s: %v\n", what, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func link(oldname, newname string) {
	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(newname), 0777), "mkdir "+filepath.Dir(newname))
	must(os.Symlink(oldname, newname), "symlink "+newname)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 4 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: mkgoroot <realGOROOT> <fakeRoot> <fixtures>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	real, fake, fixtures := os.Args[1], os.Args[2], os.Args[3]

	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), 0777), "mkdir fake src/logos")

	ents, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(real, "src"))
	must(err, "read real src")
	for _, e := range ents {
		if e.Name() == "logos" {
			continue
		}
		link(filepath.Join(real, "src", e.Name()), filepath.Join(fake, "src", e.Name()))
	}

	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(filepath.Join(real, "src", "logos"))), "copy support sources")
	must(os.CopyFS(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), os.DirFS(fixtures)), "install fixture packages")

	// The package index distinguishes .lgo-only standard packages, but
	// bypasses files with recent mtimes. Age only the private copies.
	old := time.Now().Add(-time.Hour)
	must(filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(fake, "src", "logos"), func(name string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil || !d.Type().IsRegular() {
			return err
		}
		return os.Chtimes(name, old, old)
	}), "age copied support and fixture files")

	link(filepath.Join(real, "pkg"), filepath.Join(fake, "pkg"))
	link(filepath.Join(real, "VERSION"), filepath.Join(fake, "VERSION"))
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "go.env")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "go.env"), filepath.Join(fake, "go.env"))
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(real, "lib")); err == nil {
		link(filepath.Join(real, "lib"), filepath.Join(fake, "lib"))
	}
}

-- dep/ejecttestcgomode/mode_cgo.go --
//go:build cgo

package ejecttestcgomode

const Native = true

-- dep/ejecttestcgomode/mode_nocgo.go --
//go:build !cgo

package ejecttestcgomode

const Native = false

-- dep/ejecttestcgoleaf/leaf.lgo --
package ejecttestcgoleaf

import "logos/ejecttestcgomode"

func Leaf() string {
	const if ejecttestcgomode.Native {
		return "native"
	} else {
		return "fallback"
	}
}

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/cgoown

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/cgoown/feat"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(feat.Name())
}

-- m/feat/feat.lgo --
package feat

// Name reports the active helper string.
func Name() string {
	return "feat"
}

-- m/feat/feat_native.go --
//go:build native

package feat

import "C"

import "logos/ejecttestcgoleaf"

// Leaf returns the native-only dependency value.
func Leaf() string {
	return ejecttestcgoleaf.Leaf()
}
